parole.testo: Inherited from Old Catalan orb (also spelled horp), from Proto-Indo-European *h₃órbʰos (“orphan”). Compare Occitan òrb, Italian orbo, Romanian orb.

parole.significato: a unit of fluid measure, equivalent to one quarter of a porró
parole.testo: Perhaps ultimately derived from Proto-Indo-European *kʷetwr̥-, the zero-grade form of *kʷetwóres (“four”).

parole.significato: wheel (a circular device capable of rotating on its axis)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Catalan roda, from Proto-Indo-European *Hret- (“to roll”). Compare Occitan ròda, French roue, Spanish rueda.
Ultimately derived from Proto-Indo-European *sl̥H-ik- (“willow”), making it akin to sàlic, salze, saule, and sarga, etc.
